sentences.en: Gifted children – Wunderkinder – display their talents at a tender age.
sentences.zh: 神童在很小的时候就展现出了他们的才华。

sentences.en: Perhaps the Earth is not the only planet gifted with life.
sentences.zh: 也许地球并不是唯一一个拥有生命的星球。

sentences.en: There is no room to doubt that he is a gifted artist.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他是一位有天赋的艺术家。
